body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them shipped to the **UK, USA, Canada, UAE and Australia** with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; any style can be stitched to your measurements for free. See delivery times for every country on our [international shipping page](/international-shipping/).

## Indian ethnic wear, straight from Jaipur

Living abroad should not mean waiting for a trip home to buy Indian clothes. Bahe Kurtiz makes every piece in our own Jaipur unit and ships it directly to you.

## Shop by country

[USA](/indian-clothes-online-usa/) · [UK](/indian-clothes-online-uk/) · [Canada](/indian-clothes-online-canada/) · [UAE](/indian-clothes-online-uae/) · [Australia](/indian-clothes-online-australia/) · [Malaysia](/indian-clothes-online-malaysia/) · [Singapore](/indian-clothes-online-singapore/)

## Where we ship

- **United Kingdom** – London, Birmingham, Leicester, Manchester and beyond
- **Canada** – Toronto, Brampton, Vancouver, Calgary
- **UAE** – Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah
- **Australia** – Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth
- **USA** – every state

## What we make

- Hand block print and embroidered kurta sets
- Georgette and taffeta silk Anarkali suits
- Cotton tunic tops and short kurtis
- Block print maxi dresses and co-ord sets

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 7–10 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 10–15 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Import duties and taxes included – nothing to pay on delivery

Questions? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886).
